title: Deterministic restricted-weight program
statement: Given a restricted-weight input, a finite set $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and a subset $S\subseteq J$, the deterministic query program first charges the construction work, queries a batch of sign-cube points whose size is the specified query count, then charges local work depending on the input and $S$, and returns the estimate determined by the answers to that batch.
hypotheses_covered: Restricted-weight input (with positive dimension, positive bias numerator, and twice the numerator at most the denominator)
caveat: The supplied descriptions do not define the construction-work amount, query count and points, local-work amount, or estimate determined by the answers.
